explanation: The English article on the war of 2008–2009 opens its background with the intifada’s end. On 8 February 2005 Mahmoud Abbas and Ariel Sharon signed a ceasefire agreement to end the Second Intifada, and on 17 March the thirteen main Palestinian factions agreed to it on condition that Israel stop its attacks. Israel completed its unilateral withdrawal from Gaza in September 2005. The article then dates the breakdown of that ceasefire to June 2006.
